english.title: Owner-driver failing to submit duplicate drivers record sheet

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an owner-driver who had completed a weekly record sheet in your driver's record book, failed to detach the duplicate sheet and deliver it to **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS ENTERED IN ITEM 4 ON FRONT SHEET..) within a period of 7 days from the date of its being completed
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(4) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was the owner- driver of a goods vehicle and was in possession of a driver's record book in which a weekly record sheet had been completed, failed to deliver the duplicate sheet to **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..) within a period of seven days from the date of its completion.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
